summary: Admin Product Management Feature Testing Complete - All backend APIs (19 tests) passed, frontend UI verified. Admin can view, edit, and delete company products and photos.

issues: 503 errors in console for some resources (non-blocking, likely external service)

seed_data_creation: Used existing company 'Saf business' (ID: f10f8092-ed6a-4c60-aeb3-69b9af627cde) with 8 products for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin product management feature fully working. Admin login uses 'username' field (not 'email'). Entreprises tab shows companies list. Clicking a company loads products in detail panel. Products show: thumbnail, name, description, price, stock status, views count. Edit/Delete buttons work. Photo gallery expands with 'Voir les X photo(s)' button. Photos can be deleted individually.
